channels.name: Zed extension registry
channels.instructions: The old prepared submission branch has been deleted. For a fresh submission, a human must follow upstream contribution/AI policies: add https://github.com/living-code-theme/zed as a submodule, pin the reviewed committed revision, and add the zed-registry.toml entry to extensions.toml. No path override is needed: extension.toml is at repository root. ZIP packaging is not registry publication. No upstream PR is created.
